test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 03 May 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: X and Y together can do a piece of work in 30 days. Z alone can do it in 60 days. If they worked together, then in how many days they can finish the work?
solution:
Given:

X and Y can do a work in 30 days, Z can do it alone in 60 days.

Formula:

(1/(X+Y)) + (1/Z) = 1/Total

Calculation:

⇒ (1/30) + (1/60) = 1/Total

⇒ Total = 20 days.

Hence, they can finish the work in 20 days.
